aggregation_rule: Preserve exact source-local wording plus a governed mapping when reviewed.
anti_inference_rule: Do not infer preparation from product style geography or vocabulary.

aggregation_rule: Preserve the source scale and mapping provenance.
anti_inference_rule: Do not convert unspecified or incompatible roast scales into a common value.

anti_inference_rule: Do not infer milk status from beverage name unless the source defines it.

allowed_values_or_definition: Stable non-personal key on a supporting evidence-unit row
aggregation_rule: Required for document or expression units derived from user-generated material.
anti_inference_rule: Username profile URL or direct personal identifier is not a document key.

aggregation_rule: Count distinct evidence_unit_key values after mirror and duplicate control.
anti_inference_rule: Raw rows quotations comments platform pages and rights-blocked candidates are not documents by default.

aggregation_rule: Count distinct evidence_unit_key values under a versioned regional-language normalization rule.
anti_inference_rule: Project translations synthetic variants and rights-blocked candidate metadata do not count.

allowed_values_or_definition: Count of admitted rights-cleared countable PREFERENCE_RESPONSE units
aggregation_rule: Count distinct evidence_unit_key values under the source's response-unit definition.
anti_inference_rule: Published aggregate sample-size metadata and ratings without acquired eligible response units do not count.

allowed_values_or_definition: Count of admitted rights-cleared countable SENSORY_SAMPLE units
aggregation_rule: Count distinct source-local independent samples or configurations by evidence_unit_key.
anti_inference_rule: Repeated measurements raw rows disclosed aggregate sample sizes and rights-blocked candidates do not count.

allowed_values_or_definition: Count of audited independent families contributing countable units to the stated reported_measure_key
aggregation_rule: Count distinct source_family_key values after admission and role gates.
anti_inference_rule: A candidate family does not contribute to an admitted-unit measure unless an admitted countable unit resolves to it.

allowed_values_or_definition: Count of admitted units eligible for the stated training role
aggregation_rule: Report per role and as a deduplicated union of evidence_unit_key values across roles.
anti_inference_rule: Multi-role eligibility admission or public visibility alone does not create extra training units.

allowed_values_or_definition: Disclosed study response count recorded as metadata only
aggregation_rule: Report outside the six regional coverage measures with source and method.
anti_inference_rule: Never add to REGIONAL_PREFERENCE_RESPONSE_COUNT or training units.

allowed_values_or_definition: Disclosed study sample or configuration count recorded as metadata only
aggregation_rule: Report outside the six regional coverage measures with source and method.
anti_inference_rule: Never add to REGIONAL_SENSORY_SAMPLE_COUNT or training units.

allowed_values_or_definition: Maximum family unit count divided by total units for one region and reported_measure_key
aggregation_rule: Calculate separately for each reported_measure_key using its declared evidence-unit type.
anti_inference_rule: Zero denominator is NOT_COMPUTABLE_ZERO_UNITS; do not mix measures.

allowed_values_or_definition: Sum of the three largest family unit counts divided by total units for one region and reported_measure_key
aggregation_rule: Use all available families when fewer than three contribute.
anti_inference_rule: Zero denominator is NOT_COMPUTABLE_ZERO_UNITS and top-three share is not representativeness proof.

allowed_values_or_definition: Inverse Simpson effective count: 1 / sum(p_family squared)
aggregation_rule: Calculate from non-negative family shares for one region and reported_measure_key.
anti_inference_rule: Zero denominator is NOT_COMPUTABLE_ZERO_UNITS; do not substitute candidate-family count for evidence coverage.
